estimates.assumptions: 400g raw minced beef; pure meat has no carbohydrates
2 tbs olive oil; pure oil has no carbohydrates
2 standard sesame seed burger buns (~70g each); typical values ~28g carb / 2g fiber per bun
1 medium onion (~110g) chopped; standard onion carb content
1/4 head iceberg lettuce (~75g) shredded; standard lettuce values
2 slices American-style cheese (~20g each); negligible carbs
2 large dill pickles (~50g each drained); standard pickle values
1 cup mayonnaise (full 220g); typical full-fat mayo has ~3-4g carb per 100g
2 tsp white wine vinegar (~10g); trace carbs only
Pinch of pepper (~0.5g); trace carbs only
2 tsp mustard (~10g); typical prepared mustard values
1.5 tsp onion salt (~9g); primarily salt but includes some dehydrated onion carbs
1.5 tsp garlic powder (~4.5g); standard garlic powder carb content
0.5 tsp paprika (~1.5g); standard paprika carb content
